const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/debian19y/.bashrc
@@
 # Codex Krill AI credentials, stored outside repositories.
 if [ -f "$HOME/.codex/krill.env" ]; then
   . "$HOME/.codex/krill.env"
 fi
+
+# Reuse the GitHub CLI credential for Codex's GitHub MCP server.
+if [ -z "${GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN:-}" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN="$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null)" && export GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN
+fi
 
 # opencode
 export PATH=/home/debian19y/.opencode/bin:$PATH
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
